_comment: Template for the private journey-expectations file (FENTON_JOURNEY_EXPECTATIONS). Copy it outside the repo, replace every value with your house's, never commit the copy. The values below are the DemoHouse values the hosted test instance and the gallery use.

values.longPageTitle: Bedroom 1 Walk-in Wardrobe and Dressing Area

comments.bedHotFlashBrokerScript: Script object id (no 'script.' prefix) the bed power control calls.
comments.bedHouseholdAwayScript: Script object id the whole-bed power control calls while one side is away.
comments.bedFirstTitle: Title of the first bed (the left side).
comments.bedFirstSheetId: Bed id the gallery opens the first bed's sheet by (FENTON_GALLERY_SHEET).
comments.bedSecondSheetId: Bed id the gallery opens the second bed's sheet by.
comments.remoteLivingRoomTitle: Title of the living-room remote (its name, as drawn).
comments.bedFirstTonightScript: Script object id that sets the first bed's level for tonight.
comments.bedFirstAsleepLevel: Asleep-stage level entity of the first bed.
comments.bedFirstAlarmSnooze: Snooze button of the first bed's alarm.
comments.bedFirstAlarmStop: Stop button of the first bed's alarm.
comments.bedFirstHotFlashButton: Hot Flash start button of the first bed.
comments.bedFirstHotFlashCancelButton: Hot Flash cancel button of the first bed.
comments.choresAdminTodoCompletionScript: Full script entity id the admin to-do list runs to complete an item.
comments.choresFirstPageId: Page id of the first resident's chores page (the 'chores.link.<id>' quick link).
comments.choresFirstPageTitle: Navigation title of the first resident's chores page.
comments.choresFirstLinkTint: Quick-link tint of the first resident, red,green,blue 0-255.
comments.choresSecondPageId: Page id of the second resident's chores page.
comments.choresSecondLinkTitle: Accessibility label of the second resident's quick link.
comments.choresSecondLinkTint: Quick-link tint of the second resident, red,green,blue 0-255.
comments.choresUnassignedLinkTint: Quick-link tint of the unassigned chores, red,green,blue 0-255.
comments.choresHomeLinkTint: Quick-link tint of the home chores, red,green,blue 0-255.
comments.choresGroceriesLinkTint: Quick-link tint of the groceries link, red,green,blue 0-255.
comments.climateHub: The whole-home hub thermostat the Climate page's mode and fan menus control.
comments.customLightsModeEntity: Lighting-mode select of the Custom Lights page.
comments.customLightsModeChoice: A non-default lighting mode the journeys pick from the mode menu.
comments.customLightsManualControl: Manual-control switch of the Custom Lights page.
comments.customLightsFirstLight: The first custom light (its tile, sheet and 'other light' list).
comments.customLightsSecondLight: A second custom light listed as 'other' in the first light's sheet.
comments.customLightsGroup: The group light Reset All targets.
comments.householdAutoLock: Front-door auto-lock toggle on the Admin page.
comments.householdOutdoorFaucets: First show-specific tile on the Admin page.
comments.householdFirstPresence: Presence-override switch of the first presence room.
comments.householdUnavailablePresence: Presence-override switch of the last presence room (unavailable in the fixtures).
comments.householdKitchenAutoReenable: Auto re-enable switch of the second presence room.
comments.householdKitchenPresence: Presence-override switch of the second presence room.
comments.householdGuestFirst: First guest toggle (the fixtures start it on).
comments.householdGuestSecond: Second guest toggle (the fixtures start it off).
comments.householdVehicleDoors: Vehicle door lock on the Vehicle page.
comments.securityVehicleLock: Vehicle door lock shown on the Security page.
comments.vacuumMainFloorMapId: Vacuum-map id of the first vacuum (the gallery's FENTON_GALLERY_VACUUM value).
comments.vacuumMusicRoomMapId: Vacuum-map id of the third vacuum (a second unit used for the settings and unavailable journeys).
comments.vacuumMainFloorEntity: Vacuum entity of the first vacuum.
comments.vacuumSecondaryModeSelect: Mode select of the third vacuum.
comments.vacuumSecondaryFanSelect: Fan select of the third vacuum.
comments.vacuumMainFloorZoneScript: Zone-clean script of the first vacuum.
comments.vacuumMainFloorCleanScript: Clean-selected-segments script of the first vacuum.
comments.vacuumMainFloorDockCleanScript: Dock-clean script of the first vacuum.
comments.vacuumMainFloorAutoCleanPause: Auto-clean pause switch of the first vacuum.
comments.fanFirstScript: Script object id of the first bathroom fan's command script.
comments.fanSecondScript: Script object id of the second bathroom fan's command script.
comments.humidifierSetLevelScript: Script object id that sets the humidifier mist level.
comments.purifierFirstFan: Fan entity of the first purifier (the manual fixture).
comments.purifierFirstModeSelect: Fan-mode select of the first purifier.
comments.purifierFourthAutoModeSelect: Auto-mode select of the fourth purifier (the auto fixture).
comments.roomsFirstFanRoom: Room page id of the first bathroom fan's room.
comments.roomsSecondFanRoom: Room page id of the second bathroom fan's room.
comments.roomsTowelRack: The first fan room's towel-rack switch.
comments.roomsAccessIncrementScript: Script entity id the room grid runs to count a room access.
comments.mediaLivingRoomCard: Accessibility id of the living-room remote card on the Media page.
comments.mediaConsoleCard: Accessibility id of a console source card.
comments.mediaConsoleScript: Script entity id the console card runs.
comments.mediaHandheldCard: Accessibility id of the handheld-console card.
comments.mediaHandheldScript: Script entity id the handheld-console card runs.
comments.mediaServerCard: Accessibility id of the server source card.
comments.mediaStreamerCard: Accessibility id of the second room's streamer card.
comments.remoteLivingRoomId: Remote id of the living-room remote (FENTON_GALLERY_REMOTE).
comments.remoteBedroomId: Remote id of the bedroom remote.
comments.remoteStudioId: Remote id of the remote with apps, devices and light sync.
comments.remoteMediaRoomId: Remote id of the remote with a device list.
comments.remoteLivingRoomRemote: Remote entity the living-room remote sends commands to.
comments.remoteLivingRoomPlayer: Media player the living-room remote launches apps on.
comments.remoteLivingRoomControl: Media player the living-room keyboard types into.
comments.remoteLivingRoomAppId: App id of the living-room remote's first app.
comments.remoteLivingRoomAppTitle: Title of the living-room remote's first app tile (the remote.app.<title> identifier).
comments.remoteStudioAppTitle: Title of the studio remote's app tile (the remote.app.<title> identifier).
comments.remoteStudioSpeakerTitle: Title of the studio remote's state-only speaker row (remote.device.<title>; it reports state and is not a button).
comments.remoteBedroomRemote: Remote entity of the bedroom remote.
comments.remoteBedroomVolumePlayer: Volume media player of the bedroom remote.
comments.remoteMuteScript: Script entity id the bedroom remote's Mute runs.
comments.remoteLaunchAppScript: Script entity id the living-room remote runs to launch an app.
comments.remoteMuteSpeakerKey: Data key of the mute script's speaker argument.
comments.remoteStudioPowerOffScript: Script entity id the studio remote's power runs when on.
comments.remoteStudioAppScript: Script entity id of the studio remote's first app.
comments.remoteProjector: Media player toggled by the media-room remote's first device row.
comments.remoteComputerPress: Input button the media-room computer row presses to turn it on.
comments.remoteSyncMode: Sync-mode select of the studio remote's light sync.
comments.remoteSyncIntensity: Intensity select of the studio remote's light sync.
comments.roomBedroomId: Room page id of the bedroom with the beds and the wake light.
comments.roomStudioId: Room page id of the room whose remote has apps, devices and light sync.
comments.roomMediaId: Room page id of the room with the projector remote.
comments.personFirstFullName: Full name of the first resident (a profile name the gallery is launched with, or the signed-in user).
comments.personSecondFullName: Full name of the second resident.
comments.personFirstEntity: Person entity of the first resident.
comments.personSecondEntity: Person entity of the second resident.
comments.bedSecondTitle: Title of the second bed (the right side).
comments.tileClosetTitle: A long, two-line tile title used to test wrapping.
comments.tileClosetFanTitle: A very long Live Activity title used to test wrapping.
comments.longPageTitle: A page title long enough to wrap in the navigation bar.
comments.remoteComputerTitle: Title of the media-room remote's computer device row.
comments.sprinklerFirstRainDelay: Rain-delay switch of the first controller.
comments.sprinklerFirstZoneValve: Valve of the first controller's first zone.
comments.sprinklerFirstProgram: Program switch of the first controller's first zone.
comments.sprinklerSecondZoneValve: Valve of the second controller's first zone.
